notes.title: Terminus: Zombie Survivors - 1.1 NPC Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/def14eec4319fab36ae980f9fa27857cbdd930be.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

The [b]1.1 NPC Update[/b] for [i]Terminus: Zombie Survivors[/i] is now live!

This is the [b]first major update[/b] since the 1.0 full release, focusing on [b]new NPC mechanics and improvements[/b], including [b]hostile NPCs, combat with survivor groups, and companion AI automation[/b]. Here’s what’s new:


[h1][b]1. Introduction of Hostile NPCs[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/b425da1ccecba918ef3bf985eaba0e0dfeca4ca6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/7097747877048e8721dc4658e35652ef1d5a000c.gif[/img]

Now, in addition to zombies, [b]hostile NPCs[/b] have been added. We've introduced [b]bandits, pickpockets, and starving elders[/b], each with unique behavior patterns.

[list]
[*] [b]Bandits[/b] will threaten you for supplies—refusing them leads to a fight.
[*] [b]Pickpockets[/b] attempt to steal your items—react quickly to retrieve them!
[*] [b]Starving elders[/b] are non-hostile but can be given food, water, or clothing, granting a temporary morale boost.
[/list]
Prepare for unpredictable encounters that add a new layer of tension to the zombie apocalypse!


[h1][b]2. Combat with Neutral NPCs[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/392bb2c94775018d4449cec09df20c34d92fc52e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/7f05fd15c268089d9d4dee849df8930a62eb281b.gif[/img]

NPCs are no longer just traders or potential allies—you can now [b]fight survivor NPCs[/b]. To support this, we’ve added [b]new NPC artwork[/b] and [b]unique voiceovers[/b]. The [b]combat system[/b] has also been expanded: NPCs can now suffer from bleeding, sprains, burns, and other status effects. The [b]threatened system[/b] has been reworked—an NPC’s [b]health and status effects[/b] now influence whether a threat attempt succeeds. If successful, the NPC will flee; if unsuccessful, they will fight back.

Additionally, [b]fortified houses[/b]—which previously served as quest hubs—[b]can now be attacked[/b]. Break down doors or windows, or use thrown weapons to initiate combat. Defeating the survivors inside offers significant rewards, but be prepared—[b]fighting multiple NPCs won’t be easy![/b]


[h1][b]3. Companion AI Automation[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/dbb65aa5d6f0abceeeee6abc9a6e5d720baca8af.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/53d639133d402e644d1da55227ce9a8f9b537ef3.gif[/img]

The [b]companion AI automation[/b] system has been added. When enabled, companions will automatically handle [b]movement, combat, scavenging, crafting, repairing, eating, drinking, and sleeping[/b]. Companions will now [b]attack enemies on their own, search furniture and corpses for items, and take care of farming and tool repairs[/b]. You can still control them directly or customize which actions are automated.

To support this feature, we’ve also added [b]new companion animations[/b].


📋Additional Gameplay and UI Improvements
[list]
[*] New attack types—[b]Slashing, Blunt, and Piercing[/b]—have been added, further differentiating weapon characteristics.
[*] [b]Critical hits[/b] can now occur, dealing approximately 5x damage when attacking the head.
[*] NPCs will now respawn over time in the world.
[*] A new [b]sandbox mode option[/b] allows you to [b]adjust NPC spawn rates and types[/b].
[*] UI and notifications have been improved—alerts will now display companion deaths and status effects.
[*] The maximum number of [b]recruitable companions[/b] has increased to [b]four[/b].
[*] You can now [b]send a companion to the Terminus, allowing you to recruit another.[/b]
[*] 📝For more details, check out the [b]full patch notes[/b] below.
[/list]

This update wouldn’t have been possible without your feedback! Thank you to everyone who participated in the beta and provided valuable suggestions. As always, we appreciate your support! If you have any thoughts on the update, feel free to share them in our [url=https://discord.gg/AaTZCeS4vh]Discord[/url] or on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1534980/discussions/]Steam forums[/url].

We hope you enjoy Version 1.1!

Thank you!


Best,
In-geon
Longplay Studios

[*] Removed the old weapon compatibility system for body parts.
[*] Changed the success of threatening NPCs from being probability-based to fixed outcomes.

[*] NPCs immediately flee if a threat is successful.
[*] Failed threats result in combat.
[*] Players can now cover or uncover windows from outside if they are open.

[/list]
[h3][b]Sandbox[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an option to adjust NPC spawn rates.
[*] Added options to control spawn rates for specific NPC types (Survivors, Bandits, Pickpockets, Starving Elder).
[*] Adjusted certain options (e.g., turn time scale) so that modifying them no longer prevents achievement progression, as they do not significantly affect difficulty.
[/list]
[h3][b]Sound[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 9 unique hit and death sounds for different NPCs.
[*] Differentiated player sounds based on male and female characters.
[*] Updated debris clearing sounds to match the new animations.
[/list]
[h3][b]User Interface[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The "Auto-close Attack Window" option now applies after picking up zombie heads if no zombies remain on the tile.
[*] Added maximum values to tooltips for character statuses.
[*] Reworded effects to display duration in turns instead of time.
[*] Added a warning popup when attacking decayed zombies to notify players of the risk of disease.
[*] Version mismatch warnings for save files now only appear for major version changes.
[*] Added notifications that include companion names when status ailments occur.
[*] Added a notification for when a companion dies.
[*] Changed debris clearing to use a menu and character animations instead of a popup.
[*] Improved character buttons to display status icons and HP.
[*] Removed the concept of character attack power and updated the attack window tooltip to display detailed factors affecting damage.
[*] Added a software cursor option to fix an issue where the mouse cursor was not visible when using Windows magnifier and similar features.
[/list]
[/expand]

notes.title: Terminus: Zombie Survivors - 1.1 Update Preview
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to share an early look at the main content coming in the [b]1.1 NPC update[/b]. Version 1.1 will focus on [b]new NPC systems[/b], including companion automation, the addition of hostile NPCs, and battles involving fortified houses. Our goal is to add depth to the survival experience and offer more diverse gameplay elements.


[h2][b]1. Companion Automation[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/f17ee741681828a7bbbbc44339a4580f8304d1af.gif[/img]

Your companion characters will now be able to [b]automatically engage in combat, eat food, read books[/b], and carry out necessary activities on their own. This update will allow you to focus more on your main character’s survival. To improve the companion automation system's functionality, we’re also working on adding various character animations for activities such as scavenging and eating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/43abe4a7103cce70d6494b7ceaf56de1c5537aee.gif[/img]

Additionally, the companion automation system is being developed with [b]customizable options[/b] so that companions can act according to your preferences. You will be able to toggle and adjust behaviors like movement style, attack patterns, weapon choices, and which types of books to read.


[h2][b]2. Introduction of Hostile NPCs[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/52ddf2b86accc05cc9ed125668ac2b595e84dbfa.png[/img]
We are adding a variety of NPCs, such as [b]bandits, pickpockets, and starving elders[/b] (non-hostile). These new NPCs will bring unique interactions, such as threatening the player to steal supplies or offering opportunities for players to help and gain morale boosts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/c4b52f6a6f193b16cc998c498bf8757924bef626.gif[/img]

To distinguish NPC combat from zombie encounters, we’re creating [b]a new combat system specifically for NPCs[/b]. Unlike zombies, NPCs will have [b]a unified HP system[/b] and be subject to unique effects based on targeted attacks, such as bleeding or sprains.

To complement this system, we’re also [b]revising the weapon mechanics[/b]. Instead of body-part-specific damage bonuses, weapons will now have different effects based on their type—[b]slashing, blunt, or piercing[/b]. For instance, slashing weapons may cause bleeding, and head-targeted attacks could deal critical damage.


[h2][b]3. Battles with Fortified Houses[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/cd17e124dbca53e4725ec50288c89312fdef801e.gif[/img]

You will now have the opportunity to [b]engage in battles[/b] involving fortified houses. These encounters, while challenging due to the presence of multiple NPCs, will reward successful players with valuable supplies.


In addition to these main updates, we’re working on adding more gameplay features, such as the [b]ability to release recruited companions[/b] and [b]unique voices for different zombies and NPCs[/b]. Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping this update, so please continue to share your ideas in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1534980/discussions/0/4757578733048984144/]the discussions[/url]! Your suggestions greatly contribute to our development.

While we’re pushing to release this new content as soon as possible, the extensive AI enhancements and content updates mean that the completion timeline is not yet set. We’ll keep you updated with any new information as it becomes available!

Thank you to everyone for supporting and enjoying Terminus: Zombie Survivors.


Best,
In-geon
Longplay Studios

notes.title: Terminus: Zombie Survivors - Version 1.0 Coming in August! (FAQs)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce that [b]'Terminus: Zombie Survivors' is set to release version 1.0 in August 2024[/b]. Thank you all for being part of this journey over the past three years during early access. While the exact release date is still being finalized, I wanted to share some frequently asked questions and their answers with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/13c39a7ffa91a8647ee8f3dcba38650bb8bf1999.png[/img]


[b]Q: When exactly is the release date in August?[/b]
A: We will announce the exact release date soon. Stay tuned for more updates!

[b]Q: Will all progress carry over to version 1.0?[/b]
A: Yes, all your progress and saved data from the early access version will carry over to version 1.0.

[b]Q: Will the game price change after the release?[/b]
A: The price will increase to $19.99 after the Steam Summer Sale ends on July 11th. Regional prices may vary according to Steam's suggested prices.

[b]Q: Are there new features or content in version 1.0?[/b]
A: The core content will remain consistent with version 0.9.10. Our focus is on polishing the art, gameplay, and UI to ensure the game is as stable and refined as possible. A supplemental update reflecting these improvements will be released soon.

[b]Q: Will updates continue after version 1.0?[/b]
A: Absolutely! We will continue to develop and improve 'Terminus: Zombie Survivors' with post-launch updates that include new content, features, and support for the Steam Workshop. Keep an eye out for more exciting additions!

[b]Q: Will the game be available on other platforms like Epic Games, GOG, or PC Game Pass?[/b]
A: No, the PC version of the game is available exclusively on Steam.

[b]Q: Will there be a console or mobile version in the future?[/b]
A: We are not considering a console version at this time. We are exploring the possibility of a mobile version, but it has not yet been finalized. Our current focus is on enhancing the quality of the PC version.

[b]Q: Will there be more platforms or languages added?[/b]
A: No, the final platforms and languages are set. The game is currently available on PC and Mac, and supports eight languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Spanish, German, and French. We have finalized these as the supported platforms and languages to ensure the sustainability of future updates.

[b]Q: What will happen to the supporter DLC? When can I register my name as a supporter?[/b]
A: The supporter DLC will be discontinued once the early access period ends. We initially offered the DLC to gain financial support during early access, and your contributions have been invaluable. We sincerely thank you again for your support! Although the DLC will no longer be available for purchase, you can still register your supporter name in the credits even after the sales have ended.


We'll be back soon with more news. Thank you for playing 'Terminus: Zombie Survivors' and for being part of our journey!

Best,
In-geon
Longplay Studios

Here's what's in store:

[h3][b]1. Two Larger Places[/b][/h3]

I'm adding [b]a Military Base and a Research Center[/b], each designed to be larger than the marina. These sites will have unique layouts and exploration elements, along with new furniture and items that fit their themes.

notes.title: Terminus: Zombie Survivors - V0.9.9 Update Preview
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I'm excited to share some of the features coming up in the Terminus: Zombie Survivors [b]V0.9.9[/b] update. This update introduces significant changes related to [b]"water."[/b] 🌊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/afeaebbbf27f3d31b774ba2099259eb934d0d2d6.gif[/img]

Here's what you can look forward to:


[h3][b]1. Introduction of Water Content[/b][/h3]

[b]Thirst System Implementation:[/b] A new survival element, thirst (hydration), will be introduced. You'll be able to manage thirst by drinking water, and new water-related items and ways to obtain water will be added. The thirst will replace the warmth status in order to keep the game from becoming too complex, and the existing warmth system will be simplified.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/0b6113057a5678a1d70a7e5ca791fb78ecbdbb2f.gif[/img]

[b]Fishing and Fish Trapping:[/b] As a new way to secure food, fishing and fish trapping will be available for use in water. Fourteen types of fish and seafood can be caught through fishing and fish trapping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/1ad95d95195d9f665466234528640d240807b9f2.png[/img]

[b]New Water-related Places:[/b] Expect new places related to water.


[h3][b]2. Cooking System Revamp and New Cooking Recipes[/b][/h3]

The existing single recipe cooking will now be revamped with diverse cooking recipes and improved cooking mechanics. The overhaul will allow various outcomes based on tools and ingredients.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/85b132377ae0e9740322baf7ee95073efdffb9e7.png[/img]


[h3][b]3. Introduction of Difficulty Levels and More Steam Achievements[/b][/h3]

I've heard a lot of requests from you for both easier and more challenging difficulty levels. Starting from version 0.9.9, the difficulty will be categorized into four levels: [i]Easy, Normal, Hard, Apocalypse[/i].
Additionally, more than 30 new Steam achievements will be added to keep your playthroughs fresh even after clearing the game. Your ideas and feedback have been instrumental in this work. Thank you for your valuable input!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/b6cc475875ccc50b00757dfe21192bda4d58e57e.gif[/img]


[h3][b]4. Additional Ending[/b][/h3]

Last but not least, an additional ending other than reaching the Terminus will be added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/23370f8d8c142c0f9c30c6b0ba679133e4710623.gif[/img]


Alongside these highlights, I'm also working on adding various features and improving gameplay and UI you've suggested.

The 0.9.9 update is extensive, so its development is taking a little longer. I will announce the release schedule once I have a clearer picture. I'm working hard to bring you these new features as soon as possible!

Thank you for your continued interest and feedback. It means a lot!

notes.title: Terminus: Zombie Survivors - Fuel and Faith Update Out Now! (v0.9.8)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/0568778b55b8a2943c9bc4eb945c67a5fa350c54.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

I'm thrilled to announce that the [b]Fuel and Faith update[/b] (V0.9.8) is now officially live. You can play version 0.9.8 in the default branch! I would like to express my gratitude to everyone who provided assistance with testing and balancing during the beta period.

In this update, I've introduced a new occupation - [b]the Pastor[/b] - and added new locations - [b]gas stations, churches, and clothing stores[/b]. There are also significant alterations to the vehicle fuel system, and I've included 30 new items like bags, beverages, and generators.


[b]Fuel and Faith Update teaser:[/b]
[previewyoutube=AAGiLAlllGo;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2][i]Three New Places[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/fb3f54357010c33aa0cf07afe5a15dc5584965ec.gif[/img]

New places - [b]gas stations, churches, and clothing stores[/b] - have been added. Each place offers specialized items like [b]fuel and clothing[/b], and you'll also find unique furniture and objects that can only be found at these specific places. Make use of these new additions to enhance your survival strategies.


[h2][i]New Fuel System[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/af038ce230aa85d7811567a9afb9d8459232b3fe.gif[/img]

I've implemented a more realistic vehicle fuel system. With the addition of [b]76 new vehicle arts[/b], vehicles now have different specifications for [b]fuel levels, fuel tank capacities, and fuel economies[/b]. Now, you can refuel, check the fuel economy, and use pumps to retrieve fuel.


[h2][i]Added Pastor Occupation[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/92a59545f6f46009c9baabddb24cbd0351d448aa.gif[/img]

[b]The 15th occupation, Pastor[/b], has been added. A Pastor is a spiritual leader with a fixed "[b]Pacifist[/b]" trait but also possesses unique abilities like '[b]Pray[/b]', which uplifts companion's morale, and '[b]Sermon[/b]', which grants a potent buff. Use this to lead your allies and build a formidable team.


[h2][i]Inventory System Upgrade[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/b333e09ccf0aabfa0c491ca1b0fb5fa1fad4bf67.gif[/img]

[b]Ten types of bags[/b] have been added. The number of bags you can wear is limited depending on their type. By wearing a bag, you can carry more items with fewer AP penalties. Also, now [b]you can store items in furniture[/b] too!


[h2][i]Generators and Refrigerators[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/162e1ef02443e03c0a7d418aac5a0336576144c9.gif[/img]

[b]Four types of generators[/b] that can supply electricity to your location have been added. Plus, now you can store and [b]preserve food in refrigerators[/b]. Find fuel, start up your generator, and keep your food fresh for longer!


[h2][i]Sandbox Expansion[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/c8d09e9f1cc4e95738f32b6608b273db87c6028a.gif[/img]

I've added options for [b]the number of each location and the amount of fuel in vehicles[/b], thus expanding the existing sandbox options. This allows you to tailor your gameplay experience.

In addition to these changes, I've introduced [b]offline mode, automatic end turn when sleep, and new traits[/b] as many of you have requested. Please check out the full patch notes below for more details. As always, thank you for playing Terminus: Zombie Survivors.

Enjoy! ⛽🙏

[h3][i]---------------------- Full Patch Notes ----------------------[/i][/h3]
[h1]Art & Animation[/h1]
[list]

[*] Added 76 new vehicle arts.
[*] Animation speed adjustments now apply to refueling and lockpicking.

[h1]Backend[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Steamworks version has been updated to the latest version (1.57).
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could swap places with a fainted character.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could use items while fainted in the item exchange window with a companion.
[*] Fixed a bug where normal zombies occasionally had high HP exceeding the maximum.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could increase a fire strength without waking up from sleep using Shift + Click.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Purity trait did not apply when increasing a fire using Shift + Click.
[*] Fixed a bug where NPCs occasionally had unique traits from other occupations.
[/list]

[h1]Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new locations: Gas station, Clothing store, Church
[*] Added a new occupation: Pastor
[*] Added 30 new items: School bag, Backpack, Tactical backpack, Hiking backpack, Fanny pack, Sling bag, Messenger bag, Tote bag, Duffle bag, Makeshift bag, Small gas can, Gas can, Makeshift siphon pump, Siphon pump, Electric siphon pump, Alarm clock, Digital watch, Bible, Rice, Pasta, Crackers, Granola bar, Energy drink, Vitamin drink, Soft drink, Denim jacket, Leather gloves, Work gloves, Knit gloves, Portable generator
[*] Bag items can be equipped to reduce the weight in the inventory, and there are limits to the number of bags that can be worn on different body parts.
[*] Gloves can be worn to increase attack power, crafting speed, and other effects, and only one can be worn at a time.
[*] Added new crafting recipes: Makeshift bag, Makeshift siphon pump
[*] Added a system to cars that includes fuel level, fuel tank capacity, storage capacity, and fuel economy.
[*] Added 4 types of generators.
[*] Added a food preservation function to refrigerators and beverage coolers.
[*] Added explorable decayed corpse objects.
[*] Added glass doors to some places.
[*] Added storage capacity to furniture. You can now store items inside furniture.
[*] Added a workbench (+20% crafting speed) to the hardware store and a tailor's workbench (+50% clothing crafting speed) to the clothing store.
[*] Added new traits 'Survival Partner' and 'Survival Squad'.
[/list]

[h1]Feature[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can play in offline mode.
[*] Added an option to adjust the number of places in Sandbox.
[*] Added an option to adjust the amount of car fuel in Sandbox.
[*] Grouped Sandbox options and made the label names more accurate.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] The maximum values for the character's stats have been changed to 30/18/24/24.
[*] The starting values for the character's stats have been changed to 25/15/20/20.
[*] Added automatic turn end when sleeping. Now you can choose when to wake up from sleep from three options.
[*] Increased the amount of energy recovered during sleep from 2 to 3 (based on 100% sleep quality).
[*] Recover 1 HP and 2 AP per turn during sleep.
[*] Changed the effect of ailments, sleeping pills, etc. on AP recovery from a fixed value to a percentage value. (e.g., headache -2 → -20%, sleeping pill -3 → -30%)
[*] Removed the continuous sleep bonus.
[*] Increased the sleep quality during the day from 50% to 70%.
[*] Changed the effect of the ‘Deep Sleep’ trait: Energy recovery during sleep is 1.5 times. You won't wake up to loud noises.
[*] If you don't set an alarm clock, you won't wake up until your energy is full or you hear a loud noise.
[*] A companion can wake up another sleeping companion.
[*] Sleep quality in tunnel has been adjusted to match that of other indoor locations.
[*] The AP recovery rate based on health has been increased from 9-11 to 10-12.
[*] The cooldown of the Athlete's Boost action has been increased from 3 to 6 turns.
[*] The method of refueling cars has been changed. You can now use a gas can to add fuel, and a siphon pump is required to retrieve it.
[*] The amount of fuel used when driving varies depending on the fuel economy of the car.
[*] The ability for fire trucks to pass through dangerous places has been removed.
[*] Removed the pathfinding function from cars.
[*] The 'Skillful Search' perk now also applies when inspecting cars and generators.
[*] When crafting a Molotov cocktail, only the stored fuel is used, not the entire gas can.
[*] The fuel required to make a Molotov cocktail has been reduced to 0.5.

notes.title: Terminus: Zombie Survivors - Fire and Crafting Update Out Now! (v0.9.7)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/524cae3ea3559b57425e4e32436049b6f9202a8c.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

[b]The Fire and Crafting Update (v0.9.7)[/b] is now live on the default branch! Thank you so much for all of your feedback during the beta period, it really did help me test and balance the game.

This update introduces a new fire and animal trapping system as well as a big change in the crafting and trading system - it also includes 1 new occupation, 7 new traits, and 51 new items.


[b]Here's a teaser![/b]
[previewyoutube=WamAwVcZwMw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2][i]New Fire System[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/ad51eb8a7e6692f22d4f925af1fbdaaa38a7b89b.gif[/img]

A new fire system has been introduced. I’ve added fire-related items such as Molotov Cocktails, Fire Extinguishers, and Fire Suits. Fire will burn items on the floor and also furniture. When zombies pass a tile that is on fire, they will be set on fire and their HP will continuously decrease.


[h2][i]New Animal Trapping System[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/482d4b7ce529cc513c46c29f65c791307bca0d6b.gif[/img]

Six new animal traps have been added so you can now catch animals yourself. All traps can be crafted, and I’ve implemented a new UI for placing them. Each trap has different materials, targets, and placement locations, so use them however you want. (A Dead Bird has been added to the list of dead animals, and you can also catch it!)


[h2][i]New Recipes and Crafting System Rework[/i][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/7946ab923bf45ce8f965995334941fd845c329c8.gif[/img]

I reworked the crafting system around the Dexterity stat. The crafting speed now differs from your Dexterity. You can craft the majority of the 50+ new items from this update, including [i]spears[/i] and [i]bows[/i]!
I should mention that I received a lot of help from you, especially on this part. Thank you all for your awesome ideas!

In addition, there are many other changes, such as an improved backpack UI and a revamped trading system. Check out the full patch notes below for more details. As always, thank you for playing Terminus.

Have fun playing! 🔥⚒️

Best,
In-geon



[h3][i]---------------------- Full Patch Notes ----------------------[/i][/h3]
[h1]Art[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added fire and soot art.
[*] Added the top view art of the zombie on fire and the burning effect in the attack window.
[*] Added fire extinguisher use motion.
[*] Added art for using pillows and blankets while sleeping.
[*] Added top view art for animal traps.
[*] Added attack effects when using slingshots, bows, and crossbows.
[*] Made the fog of war brighter during the day.
[*] Reworked overall items’ art sizing to fit the improved backpack UI.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where construction workers would not get diseases when killing decayed zombies with furniture.
[*] Fixed a bug where planting crops consumed 5 AP differently than displayed AP.
[*] Fixed a bug where zombies would sometimes not look player even though they recognized the player.
[*] Fixed a bug where the character would not wake up when clicking the Take All or Drop All buttons.
[*] Fixed a bug where zombies couldn’t find their way through cars in railroad places.
[*] Fixed an occasional crash when changing screen modes.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn’t click on companions when they were sleeping on the couch.
[/list]

[h1]Content[/h1]

notes.title: Terminus: Zombie Survivors - V0.9.6 Evolution Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

V0.9.6 [b]Evolution Update[/b] is out now! I have uploaded the V0.9.6 to the default branch. Many thanks to those who helped fix bugs and improve balance during the Beta.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/0597f22b5d50945d10f4765f4c70185c6862c60f.png[/img]

I have added [b]Twelve new special zombies[/b] in this update! 🧟 — [i]Helmet Zombie, Police Officer Zombie, Firefighter Zombie, SWAT Zombie, Construction Worker Zombie, Zombie Runner, Fat Zombie, Nimble Zombie, Tough Zombie, Big Zombie, Listener Zombie, Decayed Zombie[/i]

[b]Evolution Update Teaser:[/b]
[previewyoutube=87ERoXV6-Pk;full][/previewyoutube]

I added new sprites for zombies and also added special zombies to diversify the gameplay. Special zombies have much more varied HP, armor, and action/attack power; some have special abilities such as bright ears or causing disease. Of course, some zombies have weaknesses, such as narrow vision or the inability to bite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/ecf7c431bf6a5e0d51f6364eada1ae8a9d587966.gif[/img]

I've also added the [b]sandbox[/b] option that many of you have requested. You can control 15 modifiers, including food, medicine, zombies, and more. You can use it after ticking the sandbox option in settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806833/e9a3668225c77d012ee9d0d6b733b46455690855.gif[/img]

There have also been many quality-of-life improvements. I added icons for status ailments, improved the UI for reading books, and added options to adjust the scale and transparency of tooltips.

Other gameplay improvements include adding new weapons and recipes. Check out the full patch notes below for more details!

I got a lot of help from you in updating this version. Thanks to [b]azy431, TF_ROADER, Batzalo, peter6179, and murlet[/b] for suggesting special zombies. Thanks to [b]Gloomster569[/b], [b]tale051212[/b] for suggesting the sandbox option. Thanks to [b]Batzalo, Uusmin, and Cablenexus[/b] for suggesting improvements to the book reading UI. Thanks to [b]Batzalo[/b] for suggesting the transparency of tooltips, and [b]totally confused[/b] for suggesting the scale of tooltips. Thanks to [b]Justin[/b], [b]Batzalo[/b] for suggesting a hotkey to turn on the light. Thank you to [b]나나[/b] for suggesting a safe distance idea. Thanks to [b]NACL[/b] for many gameplay improvement ideas. Thank you to everyone who submitted bugs and suggestions by discussions and e-mail.

As always, thank you for playing Terminus: Zombie Survivors. Terminus' growth is entirely thanks to all of you who have joined Early Access, and I am very grateful.
I hope you also enjoy playing this version and have a great time. Thank you!

Best,
In-geon



[h3][i]---------------------- Full Patch Notes ----------------------[/i][/h3]

[h1]Art & Animation[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added art for 70 zombies and their body parts destroyed.
[*] Added 14 sets of zombie art and animations in the top view.
[*] Improved top view art of existing zombies.
[*] Increased the character’s base movement speed by 10% at 1x speed.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed inaccurate mouseover range when there are multiple zombies or zombies with furniture on the same tile.
[*] Fixed a bug where some zombies would pass through doors even after repairing them.
[*] Fixed a bug where text would be entered even when the text field was unfocused.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could use some items, including gun parts, without waking up.
[/list]

[h1]Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 12 special zombies: Helmet Zombie, Police Officer Zombie, Firefighter Zombie, SWAT Zombie, Construction Worker Zombie, Zombie Runner, Fat Zombie, Nimble Zombie, Tough Zombie, Big Zombie, Listener Zombie, Decayed Zombie.
[*] Added 14 zombie traits: Head Protected, Fully Protected, Fully Armored, Strong, Mighty, Fat, Fast, Slow, Good Reflexes, Decayed, Good Hearing, Unable to Bite, Wide Vision, Narrow Vision.
[*] Special zombies have up to 3 zombie traits.
[*] Changed the previous zombie’s status based on their HP to Crawling, Armless, and Limbless traits.
[*] Added new weapon items: Nail Bat, Barbed Wire Bat
[*] Added new material items: Nails, Wire, Barbed Wire
[*] Added new recipes: Nailed Bat, Barbed Wire, Barbed Wire Bat
[/list]

[h1]Feature[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added sandbox option. You can enable it in Settings > Games. You can change 15 settings before starting the game: the amount of food, medicine, melee weapon, ranged weapon, ammunition, tool, electronics, clothing, book, part, car, car fuel, zombies, zombie spawn rate, and special zombie ratio.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Normal zombie’s body max HP has been reduced from 10 to 5.
[*] The chance of food items being found in houses increased.
[*] Terminus Survivors’ cover shots increased from 10 to 12.
[*] Default zombie increase rate from 1 per 1 hour to 1 per 2 hours.
[*] Added Quality stat to melee weapons/tools. Depending on the Quality, the damage varies by -20%/+20%, and durability reduction varies by -40%/+40%.
[*] When crafting tools/weapons, the durability of the result is now always 100%, and the Quality varies depending on Dexterity.
[*] Revised the calculation of the value of melee weapons/tools to consider their Quality.
[*] Added the safe distance of 3 from zombies when moving to new places; It is only applied to areas you have not visited.
[*] Changed the way guidebooks are read. You get the place’s location information whenever you read certain pages (17-23).
[*] Changed the way novels are read. Restores 2 morale per 1 AP and reduces morale increase by 0.1.
[*] Added armor to some special zombies. HP does not run out until armor becomes 0.
[*] Gun shop spawn count increased from 2 to 3.
[*] The maximum amount of fuel found in cars has been increased to 4.
[*] Listener zombies have a 100% chance of finding a survivor. (Unless the Survivor has the Quiet trait)
[*] Reduced chance for normal zombies to recognize survivors in buildings. (5% → 3%)
[*] Attacking Decayed Zombies at close range causes Disease.
[*] Slightly increased the rifle’s value and reduced the weight of some tools by 20%.
[*] Changed the term Mode to Scenario and set the name of the default scenario to “Sanctuary.”
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added tooltip scale option. (Settings > Graphics)
[*] Added tooltip background opacity option. (Settings > Graphics)
[*] Removed the book reading popup; You can read a book by right-clicking it in the backpack.
[*] You can read a Book/Thick Book/Guidebook using all APs by holding right-clicking it.
[*] Book’s tooltip now describes the skill you can get and shows how many you have earned.
[*] Added icon to show when zombies have strengths or weaknesses.
[*] Added armor to the zombie tooltip’s HP indicator.
[*] Added icons to be displayed over the character in case of status ailments (Bleeding, Sprain, Disease, Infection).
[*] Added text to the bottom of the menu popup so you can check your current sandbox settings.
[*] Added water resistance to the character detail panel.
[*] Added hotkey ‘L’ to turn on the lights.
[*] Changed the default hotkey for moving places to ‘P’.
[*] Changed the default hotkey for hiding the tooltip to ‘Left Ctrl’.
[*] Changed the order of settings hotkeys so that important keys come first.
[*] Changed default hotkey for End Turn to Spacebar.
[*] Changed the name of the Enter key from “RETURN” to “ENTER.”
[*] If the Enter key is registered as a hotkey, the Enter key on the keypad performs the same function.
[*] Right-clicking on the road map modal to close the modal.
[*] Slide bars of the settings popup (tooltip scale, volume, etc.) can be adjusted by mouse scrolling.
[*] Adjusting animation speed is now working to all button progress bars, which was not in some popups, including the cooking and crafting popups.
[/list]

Hey everybody,

I released V0.9.4, which was in the beta branch as the default branch. In this version, I added a [b]Trait[/b] system. Traits can give your character a different personality in addition to occupations and stats. At the start of the game, you can use points to select traits as many as the number of classes you cleared. In this update, 50 traits have been added.

[list]
[*] [b]Alcohol Preference[/b]: You like alcohol. You can recover Morale by drinking alcohol.
[*] [b]Cigarette Preference[/b]: You like cigarettes. You can recover Morale by smoking cigarettes.
[*] [b]Coffee Preference[/b]: You like coffee. You can recover Morale by drinking coffee.
[*] [b]Weather Forecast[/b]: You can know of changes in the weather an hour in advance.
[*] [b]Carb Lover[/b]: Morale increases more when eating bread or sweets.
[*] [b]Vegetarian[/b]: Morale increases more when eating vegetables or fruits.
[*] [b]Deep Sleep[/b]: Continuous Sleep bonus is increased by 10% per turn, up to a max of 80%.
[*] [b]Beastly Resilience[/b]: Restores from status ailments (bleeding, etc.) twice as fast when sleeping.
[*] [b]Good Stomach[/b]: Morale no longer decreases when eating.
[*] [b]Music Lover[/b]: Morale increase is doubled when listening to music.
[*] [b]Purity[/b]: Each time you burn an unread book or a thick book, your Morale increases by 1.
[*] [b]High Social Awareness[/b]: Reliability increases more when communicating with other survivors.
[*] [b]Foodie[/b]: Morale gained by eating is doubled.
[*] [b]Parkour[/b]: Avoid sprains when crossing windows or fences.
[*] [b]Homeless[/b]: You can sleep outside the building.
[*] [b]Neighborhood Resident[/b]: Start by knowing the location of the 10 places around you.
[*] [b]Reading Lover[/b]: Morale increases by 5 each time a whole book is read.
[*] [b]DIY Lover[/b]: Morale increases by 5 each time you craft.
[*] [b]Favorite Weapon[/b]: You can set 1 melee weapon as a favorite weapon. Receive a 100% repair bonus when repairing a favorite weapon.

[*] [b]Exquisite Dismantler[/b]: You get another piece of meat when you dismantle an animal.
[*] [b]Veteran I[/b]: Start with the occupation’s unique perk level 2.
[*] [b]Sleep Lover[/b]: Morale recovered through sleep is doubled.
[*] [b]Nocturnal[/b]: Energy is not reduced at night.
[*] [b]Thorough Preparation[/b]: Prepared plenty of supplies at the starting place.
[*] [b]Shooting Training[/b]: Ranged weapon proficiency will increase by 2.
[*] [b]Light Eater[/b]: Satiety reduction per turn will be 0.5.
[*] [b]High Endurance[/b]: Energy reduction per turn will be 0.5.
[*] [b]Optimist[/b]: Morale reduction per turn will be 0.5.
[*] [b]Melee Training[/b]: Melee weapon proficiency will increase by 2.
[*] [b]Drug Addict[/b]: The effectiveness of the medicine is increased by 50%.
[*] [b]Strong Body[/b]: Max HP is 25.
[*] [b]Healthy Body[/b]: Max AP is 25.
[*] [b]Unnoticed[/b]: The line of sight of zombies that detect you is decreased by 25%.
[*] [b]Thick Skin[/b]: Reduces the possibility of bleeding and damage of zombie’s claw attacks by half.
[*] [b]Treasure Hunter[/b]: Find bullets and jewelry on the ground.
[*] [b]Very Strong Body[/b]: Max HP is 30.

With the addition of the trait system, I have integrated the existing preference system (alcohol, cigarette, coffee) into the trait. notes.title: Terminus - Update 0.9.3
notes.notes:
Hi. This is the first update for 2022!

I released the V0.9.3 version that was in the beta branch as the default branch. This version includes a new place, new items, a new action, a new survival skill, and more.

In this update, I’ve focused on enhancing the gameplay. The most significant change is Sleep. The Sleep action replaces the existing Rest action. You now need to Sleep sometimes to restore energy and morale. The previous Rest action was a bit simple, so I hope the new Sleep system adds a more realistic feeling and depth to the game. I will gradually add furniture and items related to Sleep. In addition, I have added various gameplay elements. You can go through dark tunnels, butcher dead animals with knives, and break furniture to get electronic parts and metal sheets. In addition to the gameplay, I also fixed bugs, added animation speed adjustment options (that many of you asked), and added code to prevent potential execution errors.

I have carefully read all the feedback you left in the reviews and discussions. Your suggestions have been very helpful in working on this version as well. Thank you. Please enjoy playing the V0.9.3. I wish you the best of luck in your life in 2022. I sincerely thank you for playing Terminus last year, and I will continue to work hard to develop this year.

Happy New Year 2022! 🎊
- In-geon

notes.title: Terminus V0.9.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello.
In this update, I added a weather system, added a mode, and improved balance. Now, in addition to the sunny weather, it is raining and snowing. I also added a new hard mode, Frozen Zombies, and updated Steam Achievement. I also improved the overall balance; I made adjustments to items’ Satiety and Morale values, revised Dexterity’s repair efficiency, and more. In addition to that, I added convenience features such as quick player actions and fast-forwarding game over scene.

[i]Thanks to the feedback, I know more about my game. Your feedback has made the gameplay better. Thank you for playing Terminus and being with it in the development process. Please enjoy playing this version too![/i]

[*] Changed the category of Seeds to Food and added 0.5 Satiety.
[*] You can find more preference items (Alcohol, Cigarette, Coffee) in grocery stores.
[*] You can find more Tool Parts in the hardware stores.
[*] The thresholds that Satiety, Warmth, Energy, and Morale affect HP and AP changed from 5, 15 to 4, 16.
[*] Satiety, Warmth, Energy, and Morale at the start of the game increased from 15 to 16.
[*] Natural recovery occurs when Satiety, Warmth, Energy, and Morale are all 16 or higher.

This update mainly focused on UI improvements, gameplay polishing, and localisations.
